items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Oh, that's my niece, one of the girls in the family.

ctx.x: Did you tell her that Sunchy and her husband came to the United States and came to see you?
Oh, that's my niece, one of the girls in the family.
That was the first time I had ever met them, they're lovely people. and she's just lovely.
